```{r, echo=FALSE}
setwd("~/Desktop")
x <- read.csv("AdCollabData.csv", as.is = TRUE)

# load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(lme4)
library(MASS)
library(ggeffects)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
length(unique(x$id))

length(unique(x$study))

length(unique(x$item_num))

length(x$rating)
```


## Politics Variable Switch 
```{r}
#x$demrep <- x$demreptemp #create temp variable 

#x$demrep <- x$demrepParty # 
#x$demrep <- x$demreptemp # JON - NEXT RUN ALL MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE AS DEMREP
#x$demrep <- x$trump2016 # JON - NEXT RUN ALL MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE AS DEMREP
#x$demrep <- x$demrep_c # STEVE WILL RUN MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE
x$demrep <- x$conservative # STEVE WILL RUN MODELS WITH THIS VARIABLE 
```

```{r}
table(x$demrep)
```

```{r}
#for demrep_c only!
#x$demrep <- (1-0)/(6-1)*(x$demrep-6)+1
```

## Recode DemRep
```{r}
x$demrep <- 1-x$demrep
```

## Remove Q, R, S, and T - these do NOT have common conservatism measure.
```{r}
x <- x %>% filter(study != "Q" & study != "R" & study != "S" & study != "T")

table(x$study)
```



Model #1: All 
```{r}
model_lmer1 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=x, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer1)
```

Model #2: No Norms 
```{r}

#Subset, No Norms
dataNoNorms <- subset(x, x$has_socialnorms == 0)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataNoNorms %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

model_lmer2 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataNoNorms, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer2)
```

Model #3: No Tips
```{r}

#Subset, No Tips
dataNoTips <- subset(x, x$has_tips == 0)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataNoTips %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Study T 
dataNoTips <- subset(dataNoTips, dataNoTips$study != "T")

model_lmer3 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataNoTips, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer3)
```

Model #4: No Norms or Tips
```{r}

#Subset, Just Norms or Tips
dataNoNormsNoTips <- subset(dataNoNorms, dataNoNorms$has_tips == 0)
xtabs(~dataNoNormsNoTips$condition)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataNoNormsNoTips %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Study T 
dataNoNormsNoTips <- subset(dataNoNormsNoTips, dataNoNormsNoTips$study != "T" & dataNoNormsNoTips$study != "N")

model_lmer4 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataNoNormsNoTips, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer4)
```

Model #5: Evaluation
```{r}

#Subset, Just Evaluation
dataEvaluation <- subset(x, x$evaluation_treatment == 1 | x$control == 1)
xtabs(~dataEvaluation$evaluation_treatment)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataEvaluation %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Study T 
dataEvaluation <- subset(dataEvaluation, dataEvaluation$study != "D" 
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "E"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "F"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "N"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "O"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "T")

model_lmer5 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataEvaluation, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer5)
```

Model #6: Evaluation & Importance
```{r}

#Subset, Just Evaluation
dataEvaluationImportance <- subset(x, x$evaluation_treatment == 1 | x$control == 1 | x$importance_treatment == 1)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataEvaluationImportance %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Studies
dataEvaluationImportance <- subset(dataEvaluationImportance, dataEvaluationImportance$study != "E"
                     & dataEvaluationImportance$study != "F"
                     & dataEvaluationImportance$study != "N"
                     & dataEvaluationImportance$study != "T")

model_lmer6 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataEvaluationImportance, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer6)
```

Model #7: Multiple Treatments 
```{r}

#Subset, Just Evaluation
dataMultiple <- subset(x, x$has_multiple == 1 | x$control == 1)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataMultiple %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Study T 
dataMultiple <- subset(dataMultiple, dataMultiple$study == "D" 
                     | dataMultiple$study == "E"
                     | dataMultiple$study == "F"
                     | dataMultiple$study == "N"
                     | dataMultiple$study == "O"
                     | dataMultiple$study == "Q"
                     | dataMultiple$study == "R"
                     )

model_lmer7 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataMultiple, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer7)
```


#### Exclusion of Non-Political News Sharers #### 

Model #8: All 
```{r}

xOnlyShare <- subset(x, ((x$headline_type_0C_1P | x$study == "J") & x$ever_share_political==1) | x$headline_type_0C_1P == 0) 

model_lmer8 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=xOnlyShare, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer8)

```

Model #9: No Norms 
```{r}

#Subset, No Norms
dataNoNorms <- subset(x, x$has_socialnorms == 0)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataNoNorms %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Only Share Political News
dataNoNormsOnlyShare <- subset(dataNoNorms, ((dataNoNorms$headline_type_0C_1P | dataNoNorms$study == "J") & dataNoNorms$ever_share_political==1) | dataNoNorms$headline_type_0C_1P == 0) 

model_lmer9 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataNoNormsOnlyShare, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer9)
```

Model #10: No Tips
```{r}

#Subset, No Tips
dataNoTips <- subset(x, x$has_tips == 0)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataNoTips %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Study T 
dataNoTips <- subset(dataNoTips, dataNoTips$study != "T")

#Only Share Political News
dataNoTipsOnlyShare <- subset(dataNoTips, ((dataNoTips$headline_type_0C_1P | dataNoTips$study == "J") & dataNoTips$ever_share_political==1) | dataNoTips$headline_type_0C_1P == 0) 

model_lmer10 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataNoTipsOnlyShare, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer10)
```

Model #11: No Norms or Tips
```{r}

#Subset, Just Norms or Tips
dataNoNormsNoTips <- subset(dataNoNorms, dataNoNorms$has_tips == 0)
xtabs(~dataNoNormsNoTips$condition)

#Check Which Studies Only Have Control Data
dataNoNormsNoTips %>% group_by(study) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(condition = mean(condition, na.rm = TRUE))

#Drop Study T 
dataNoNormsNoTips <- subset(dataNoNormsNoTips, dataNoNormsNoTips$study != "T" & dataNoNormsNoTips$study != "N")

#Only Share Political News
dataNoNormsNoTipsOnlyShare <- subset(dataNoNormsNoTips, ((dataNoNormsNoTips$headline_type_0C_1P | dataNoNormsNoTips$study == "J") & dataNoNormsNoTips$ever_share_political==1) | dataNoNormsNoTips$headline_type_0C_1P == 0) 

model_lmer11 <- lmer(rating ~ headline_true*treated*demrep + (1+headline_true|study/id) + (1+treated*demrep|item_num), data=dataNoNormsNoTipsOnlyShare, control = lmerControl(optimizer ="bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
summary(model_lmer11)
```

Model #12: Evaluation

```{r}
#Subset, Just Evaluation

                     & dataEvaluation$study != "E"
                     & dataEvaluation$study != "F"
```

#Get Coeficients And P-Values
```{r}

c1 <- coef(summary(model_lmer1))[8, 1]
c2 <- coef(summary(model_lmer2))[8, 1]
c3 <- coef(summary(model_lmer3))[8, 1]

coefs <- rbind(c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14)

p1 <- coef(summary(model_lmer1))[8, 5] #

p11 <- coef(summary(model_lmer11))[8, 5]

p13 <- coef(summary(model_lmer13))[8, 5]
p14 <- coef(summary(model_lmer14))[8, 5]

pvalues <- rbind(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, p13, p14)

results <- cbind(coefs, pvalues)
View(results)
```
